# wave9: the RETURN ADDRESSES a Lua-error unwind climbs through. Backward
# closure over the call graph from lua_pcall's setjmp runner (0x471590):
# for every function already on the chain, the address just after each call
# TO it, recursively. wave8 lifted the setjmp resume points themselves; the
# unwinder then failed one hop LATER, at an ordinary return address, which
# is what this set is. Call sites found by exact byte match on `E8 rel32`.
